newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka tenders for 100,000 tonnes hard wheat.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders for 100,000 tonnes hard wheat.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state buying arm, the Co-operative Wholesale Establishment, has tendered for 100,000 tonnes of hard wheat in two lots of 50,000 tonnes each, government officials said on Monday.

The first lot is for delivery between May 22-June 5 for wheat coming from ports in the United States, Canada, the Continent and Argentina, and between June 10-19 for ports in Australia and Saudi Arabia, they said.

The second lot is for delivery during June 16-25 for wheat coming from ports in the United States, Canada, the Continent and Argentina, and for ports in Australia and Saudi Arabia it is for delivery during June 30-July 9.
